Your holdings: SOXL (-75.06%) and MUU (-59.4%) are deep in the red with "SELL" status and stops that are far from current prices. QQQ (-5.58%) is also flagged "TRIM" and nearing its stop. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on broader market sentiment regarding interest rates, as Goldman Sachs is changing its Fed forecast. Also, watch for any follow-through on the positive AI/chip news.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your deeply underwater, leveraged positions while staying alert to macro shifts.
plays: Review your stop loss on SOXL (current price 56.06, stop 200) given the -75% loss and "SELL" status. This stop is not protecting you.
Re-evaluate your stop loss on MUU (current price 15.1, stop 31.6) for the same reasons as SOXL.
